rationale: The Court is likely to hold that Heck is not a categorical bar to prospective declaratory/injunctive relief and instead requires a claim- and remedy-specific inquiry into whether success would necessarily imply the invalidity of the outstanding conviction, with remand for narrowing/tailoring. Expect at least one dissent (likely by Justice Alito, possibly with the Chief and/or Justice Thomas) arguing the requested relief here functionally collaterally attacks the conviction and should be barred under Heck/Preiser.
